game.rules:
**Run Timing**

Timing for every category is RTA. Taking short breaks is technically allowed but will still count towards final times.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof**

Game video & audio proof is required for submissions below their category's threshold. For PC runs, you should also have your mouse cursor visible. Nothing should cover up any major gameplay elements (sun counter, coin counter, level progress bar, etc.).

Submitting runs from YouTube or Twitch is recommended, but if you submit from Twitch, submit a highlight and **not** a past broadcast so it can be viewed permanently.

For retiming purposes, try to include at least 1-2 seconds of video before the run starts and after the run ends.

---------------------------------

**Gameplay and Emulation**

Any sort of game modifications are banned.

**PC:** Runs on any release (GOTY or not doesn't matter) can simply be submitted under PC subcategories due to having no major differences. Things that would give an unfair advantage with mouse movement (auto-clickers, touchscreens, etc.) are banned. Closing and reopening the game is allowed unless it is used to reset grave layouts or Crazy Dave's plant choices on the level you're currently on. Runs performed on a PowerPC Mac are banned due to a game speed bug unique to that platform.

**Console (360/PS3/Vita):** Runs on emulators are allowed, but make sure to note in submissions that they're emulated (Xenia/RPCS3 are preferable).

**DS:** Runs on emulators are allowed, but make sure to note in submissions that they're emulated (melonDS/DeSmuME are preferable). Using save states is banned. No load retiming is currently necessary.

---------------------------------

**Technical Setup**

If you need any additional help with figuring out how to record gameplay, set up splits/autosplitting or fix any technical problems, feel free to check the Resources/Guides tabs on this page or join our Discord server, we're always open for questions.

---------------------------------

**Mobile Leaderboard**

https://www.speedrun.com/pvzm

challengeList.rules:
# **Main Rules**

- Runs must have video footage with game audio, and must be at a minimum of 30fps
- For retiming purposes, try to include at least 1-2 seconds of video before the run starts and after the run ends.
- Runs must be performed on the current patch of the game (It does not matter if its GOTY edition or not)
- Runs must be performed on a vanilla version of the game with no modifications (this unfortunately also includes unofficial translated versions of the game)
- Your mouse cursor should be visible 
- Nothing should cover up any major gameplay elements including sun counter, coin counter, level progress bar, etc.
- No macros, autoclickers, or otherwise external tools
- Runs may be performed on any official platform, but it should be noted that PC is the fastest one.
- Runs performed on a PowerPC Mac are banned due to a game speed bug unique to that platform.

# **Category**

### **Individual Worlds - Day** 

- Complete the respective worlds from 1-1 to 1-10.

# **Timing**

- Time starts on the first frame that a peashooter is planted on 1-1
- Time ends on clicking on the seed packet after beating 1-10
- Run timing is done RTA (Real-Time Attack)
- Using LiveSplit is encouraged, but not required

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Complete Adventure mode from a fresh file.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts when you place the first plant in 1-1. Timing ends when you grab the Silver Sunflower Trophy after defeating Dr. Zomboss.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for runs below 4:30:00.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: All Mini-games
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Beat every mini-game, including ones exclusive to certain releases. Any order is allowed.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame of the first level you play. Timing ends on clicking on the coin bag/trophy after beating the last level.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run. Having all the mini-games unlocked or beaten beforehand is also allowed.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for runs below 2:00:00.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Complete the respective level.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame of the level. Timing ends on clicking on the coin bag/trophy at the end.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run. Having the level beaten beforehand is also allowed.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for top 10 submissions.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: All Puzzles
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Beat all 18 completable puzzle levels. Any order is allowed.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame of the first level you play. Timing ends on clicking on the coin bag/trophy after beating the last level.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run. Having all the puzzles unlocked or beaten beforehand is also allowed.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for runs below 20:00.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: All Survivals
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Beat all 10 completable survival levels. Any order is allowed.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame of the first level you play. Timing ends on clicking on the coin bag/trophy after beating the last level.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run. Having all the survival levels unlocked or beaten beforehand is also allowed.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for runs below 2:40:00.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

**Objective**

Earn the Gold Sunflower Trophy by completing Adventure (only once) and collecting every mini-game, puzzle, and survival trophy, starting from a fresh file.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on placing the first plant in 1-1. Timing ends when you collect the Gold Sunflower Trophy after beating the last objective.

---------------------------------

**Achievements**

Completing achievements unique to certain releases isn't required for the run.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof**

Required for all runs due to this category's difficult nature.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: NG+
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Complete Adventure Mode on a file that has already beaten Dr. Zomboss before, starting at 1-1.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts after clicking past Crazy Dave's last text box before the start of 1-1. Timing ends when you grab the coin bag after defeating Dr. Zomboss.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for runs below 5:30:00.

---------------------------------

**Glitches**

In glitchless runs, using the autosave exploit exclusive to the Steam GOTY release to skip a level is not allowed.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: Normal Survivals
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Beat all 5 Normal **(not Hard)** difficulty survival levels. Any order is allowed.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame of the first level you play. Timing ends on clicking on the coin bag/trophy after beating the last level.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run. Having all the survival levels unlocked or beaten beforehand is also allowed.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for runs below 1:00:00.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

categories.name: Survival: Endless
categories.rules:
**Objective**

Complete the required number of flags of Survival: Endless, starting from the beginning.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame after entering the level. Timing ends when the final zombie dies on the last wave and the "More zombies approaching!" text appears.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for top 5 submissions.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

Get to a streak of 15 in Vasebreaker Endless. Timing ends when the "More vases incoming!" text appears after beating the 15th wave. You must start from the beginning.

runList.comment: finally did it

There's a lot of decisions I regret that could have got me world record. 1-6 had a massive blunder as did 1-10, and those could have got me a day challenge PB too. Pool was consistently mediocre, fog had some real blunders (both the 4-6 and the 4-7 final wave...), and my pumpkin glooming was rough on roof.

But. All of those decisions are outweighed by the best decision I have ever made when it mattered the most... on 5-9.

(Also 2-4 global is cool)

Extremely good run that ended up being a wr by 9 seconds. 

Day was on pace for an easy WR if 1-10 hadn't sucked so much, still really good. Night was also good but nothing insane. Then came pool with a sub 48 after getting an insane 3-10 on top of very good levels overall, giving me my best pool ever and 2nd best community pool exit (the best one had happened only a few hours ago too!). Fog wasn't great but it wasn't terrible either, 4-6 and 4-10 had bad rng but overall I played it ok. Roof was probably the worst world with a few misplays such as not using jalapeno on wave 7 in 5-1 and letting an ambush cone escape on 5-8. I also didn't have glooms for 5-4 and got some bad rng on 5-3. Still zomboss came in clutch to save the run!

Overall the only bad levels were 1-10, 4-6, 5-1 and 5-8
Best levels were 1-8, 3-10 (both golds) 1-6, 2-2, 3-3, 5-6

Very good rng and execution.
Ending was a little bit rough - extra garg on wave 29 on 5-9, not a 3 cycle 5-10 which could be 30s faster.
Bad executed pool and fog
*tactical 1:08 night exit*
i did it
Really solid run!
2nd place is mine!
no

This was just a really strong run overall. Day was middling, and the first part of Fog and Roof were kinda bad, but otherwise there was a lot to like about this. Night was unbelievable, Pool overall solid, and the back halves of Fog and Roof were great. 4-5 and 5-7 golds too. Who knows when 3:22 will happen, but this felt good.

Unlucky latter half of Day, Unlucky latter half of Night, Badly Executed Pool and Fog. Crazy 4-10 and Roof turned run around and then some. Very beatable but took the run for experience/practice over grinding for a new personal best. Very impressive >1.5-minute-PB that I wasn't expecting from a No-Reset Run. Practicing and No-Resetting is in my future... but again, the next few months will likely broker no quarter at the very least.

Also like I said before, everything after 4-10 was really good except the 5-2, 5-3 and 5-4, especially with no Roof Cleaners. Comparing will be incredibly tough without practice/improvement.

categories.rules:
**Objective**

Complete the respective level.

---------------------------------

**Timing**

Timing starts on the first frame of the level. Timing ends on clicking on the coin bag/trophy at the end.

---------------------------------

**Save File**

All shop items (rakes, extra seed slots, etc.) are allowed, including buying a rake before the start of the run. Having the level beaten beforehand is also allowed.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof** 

Required for top 10 submissions.

---------------------------------

**Game Rules**

Please also make sure to check the 'Game Rules' tab for more information.

games.name: Plants vs. Zombies
games.rules:
**Run Timing**

Timing for every category is RTA. Taking short breaks is technically allowed but will still count towards final times.

---------------------------------

**Video/Audio Proof**

Game video & audio proof is required for submissions below their category's threshold. For PC runs, you should also have your mouse cursor visible. Nothing should cover up any major gameplay elements (sun counter, coin counter, level progress bar, etc.).

Submitting runs from YouTube or Twitch is recommended, but if you submit from Twitch, submit a highlight and **not** a past broadcast so it can be viewed permanently.

For retiming purposes, try to include at least 1-2 seconds of video before the run starts and after the run ends.

---------------------------------

**Gameplay and Emulation**

Any sort of game modifications are banned.

**PC:** Runs on any release (GOTY or not doesn't matter) can simply be submitted under PC subcategories due to having no major differences. Things that would give an unfair advantage with mouse movement (auto-clickers, touchscreens, etc.) are banned. Closing and reopening the game is allowed unless it is used to reset grave layouts or Crazy Dave's plant choices on the level you're currently on. Runs performed on a PowerPC Mac are banned due to a game speed bug unique to that platform.

**Console (360/PS3/Vita):** Runs on emulators are allowed, but make sure to note in submissions that they're emulated (Xenia/RPCS3 are preferable).

**DS:** Runs on emulators are allowed, but make sure to note in submissions that they're emulated (melonDS/DeSmuME are preferable). Using save states is banned. No load retiming is currently necessary.

---------------------------------

**Technical Setup**

If you need any additional help with figuring out how to record gameplay, set up splits/autosplitting or fix any technical problems, feel free to check the Resources/Guides tabs on this page or join our Discord server, we're always open for questions.

---------------------------------

**Mobile Leaderboard**

https://www.speedrun.com/pvzm
